QUOTE: The `error.c` file is not hand-written. `library/CMakeLists.txt:134` runs `scripts/generate_errors.pl` as a custom command. Its inputs are the public headers (`error_headers`) and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`, and its output is `${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/error.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated by scripts/generate_errors.pl from the public headers with error.fmt as an input (template).
